checks.summary: The selected profile and overlays satisfy their declared runtime schemas.
Required authoritative overview context is present or an approved exception is recorded.
Material claims are traceable and include required population, period, and source context.
Evidence states are explicit and are not converted into a stronger state.
Narrative, tables, registers, and appendices contain no unresolved material contradiction.
No fact, owner, date, target, agreement, or commitment is introduced without authority.
A new artifact contains no source-specific sample facts or accidental formatting artifacts.
Automated repair preserves protected facts, decisions, requirements, targets, and commitments.
Any language-conformance status is limited to the configured scope and approved prerequisites.
Themes connect to goals and initiatives, targets are explained, and resource asks state consequences.
The decision, invariants, comparable options, supported recommendation, and actions are present.
Every case connects evidence, outcome, mechanism, validation, and roadmap linkage.
Requirements are atomic, observable, traceable, prioritized, and verifiable, with rollback coverage.
Exposure, contamination controls, telemetry failure behavior, and data-quality gates are defined.
Each activated capability includes objective, flow, requirements, acceptance, telemetry, dependencies, failure behavior, and deferred scope.
Changed behavior has one lifecycle state and a learning-to-decision-to-delta chain or approved exception.
Column order, required fields, durable IDs, duplicate keys, priorities, and acceptance criteria are valid.
The ask or answer, recipient roles, owners, deadlines, sensitivity handling, and explicit send approval are valid.
